result:
Perfect! All tests pass now. ✓

**The bug:** Line 54 in `src/lib.rs` had the merge condition `s.start < last.end`, which only merged overlapping spans but not touching spans.

**The fix:** Changed it to `s.start <= last.end` to also merge spans that touch each other (where one ends exactly where the next begins). This correctly handles the half-open range semantics where [1, 4) and [4, 6) are adjacent and should merge into [1, 6).
